say:0:1536009001:1.text: What used to be a lively, thriving neighborhood is now nothing but rubble. Crumbling walls, shattered stone, cracks choked with yellow sand... Just standing nearby makes your throat burn and your eyes sting.
say:0:1536009001:1.source_cn: 旧日繁荣的、生机勃勃的民居，如今只剩断壁残垣。墙皮剥落...

say:0:1536009001:1.female: What used to be a lively, thriving neighborhood is now nothing but rubble. Crumbling walls, shattered stone, cracks choked with yellow sand... Just standing nearby makes your throat burn and your eyes sting.

say:1:1536009002:1.text: There's nothing left here. Just Anton's grave, standing lonely and forgotten, surrounded by the hollow husks of insect eggs left to rot.
say:1:1536009002:1.source_cn: 这里什么也没有剩下。安东的墓碑空落落地立在那里，只有同...

say:2:1536009003:1.text: Anton fought until the bitter end and somehow held on to his last breath. He gave his life for Halia. A casualty of divine corruption. He doesn't deserve to be forgotten.
say:2:1536009003:1.source_cn: 安东战斗到了最后的绝境，又拼命活到了最后一刻。他是为呼...

say:3:1536009004:1.text: You suddenly remember his final request—he asked you to return his medal to his mother, <style="highlight">Nelia</style>, back in Halia.
say:3:1536009004:1.source_cn: 你忽然想起安东的遗愿。他请求你将他的勋章带回呼临城，交...

say:3:1536009004:1.female: You suddenly remember his final request—he asked you to return his medal to his mother, <style="highlight">Nelia</style>, back in Halia.

say:4:1536009005:1.text: Maybe it's time to find her. It's the least you can do to honor his memory.
say:4:1536009005:1.source_cn: 或许你可以试着找找他的母亲。至少，别就这样忘了他。
